name: super-outer-learning
description: Optional Super-outer skills: Brief me explains the words a new field uses before you build, and Meditate writes a visual study of how the thing you built works and what your decisions changed

interface.shortDescription: Learn a field's words before you build and study the work afterwards.
interface.longDescription: Super-outer Learning adds two optional skills to Super-outer. Brief me takes the kind of project you are about to start, such as a browser game or an AI music track, and returns a glossary of the terms you will need to describe it, three clarifying questions and a diagram page. Meditate reads a finished session and writes a private HTML study: a diagram of the parts you built or changed and what passes between them, your corrections placed on the parts they changed, questions that ask you to predict what one change would do, short principles and a page of words for directing the next task.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Super-outer Learning to brief me on the vocabulary of this project before I build it, or to meditate on the work I have just finished.
